160 PRINT "LOAD: CALL&";HEX$(A);", NEW first"
170 PRINT "SAVE: CALL&";HEX$(A+256)
180 GOSUB 300:END
200 U=INT((Q+3)/4):IF U<1 THEN LET U=1
205 V=4*U-Q:IF V>8 THEN LET V=8
207 RETURN
300 N=A+576:POKE N,255:K=INT(N/256):L=N-256*K:W=K+128-256*INT(K/128)
310 POKE 65084,L:POKE 65085,K:POKE 65087,L:POKE 65088,K
320 POKE 63589,W:POKE 63590,L:POKE 63591,W:POKE 63592,L
330 RETURN
